title: Aligning Forest and Trees in Images & Long Captions for Visually Grounded Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2602.02977v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models such as CLIP often struggle to faithfully understand long, detail-rich captions, relying on dominant scene cues while overlooking fine-grained visual evidence. We propose a hierarchical vision-language learning principle for understanding scenes as part-to-whole compositions: before forming a whole-scene representation, a model should uncover what semantic parts appear where in the image. To this end, we propose CAFT (Cross-domain Alignment of Forest and Trees), a vision-language model that jointly learns local text-region alignment at intermediate representations and global image-text alignment at the final representation. Exploiting the organization of long captions, where local descriptions often correspond to scene parts, CAFT employs a fine-to-coarse image encoder and a part-whole text encoder to discover localized part semantics and progressively compose them into a global image-text representation.

translated_title: 对齐图像与长文本描述中的“森林”与“树木”以实现视觉接地理解
translated_abstract: 诸如CLIP等视觉-语言模型往往难以忠实理解长而细节丰富的描述文本，它们依赖主导性的场景线索而忽视细粒度的视觉证据。我们提出了一种层次化的视觉-语言学习原则，将场景理解为部分到整体的组合：在形成整体场景表示之前，模型应该揭示哪些语义部分出现在图像中的什么位置。为此，我们提出了CAFT（森林与树木的跨域对齐，Cross-domain Alignment of Forest and Trees），这是一种视觉-语言模型，它在中间表示层面联合学习局部文本-区域对齐，并在最终表示层面学习全局图像-文本对齐。利用长文本描述的组织结构（其中局部描述通常对应场景的各个部分），CAFT采用由细到粗的图像编码器和部分-整体的文本编码器，以发现局部化的部分语义，并逐步将其组合成全局的图像-文本表示。
tldr: 提出CAFT模型，通过“由细到粗”的层次化学习同时实现局部文本-区域对齐与全局图像-文本对齐，使视觉-语言模型能够忠实理解长而细节丰富的图像描述。
en_tdlr: CAFT is a vision-language model that jointly learns local text-region alignment at intermediate representations and global image-text alignment at final representations in a fine-to-coarse hierarchical manner, enabling faithful understanding of long, detail-rich captions.
